{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./land_use.flux.sh [args]`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Submit translated resources from Slurm:
#   --nodes=1        -> -N 1
#   --time=30:00:00  -> -t 30h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -t 30h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner $*" )

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  shift

  # NOTE: Slurm --job-name=land_use not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm --account=POLARIS not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; depending on site policy, submission may require a project/account specified out-of-band.

  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=bdwall not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing a specific partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mail-user / --mail-type not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: no email notifications.

  set -eu

  main() {
      cd /lcrc/project/POLARIS/bebop/SMART_FY22_LAND_USE/PILATES-SRC-JA
      module_load
      setup_venv
      . venv/bin/activate
      python3 ./run.py "$@"
  }

  setup_venv() {
      python3 -m pip install --user virtualenv
      [[ -d venv ]] || virtualenv venv
      . venv/bin/activate
      # python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
  }

  module_load() {

      # BEBOP
      module load gcc/10.2.0-z53hda3
      module load python/3.8.10-6kl7zkj
      module load singularity/3.6.4

      python3 -m ensurepip --upgrade
  }

  main "$@"
fi
"
}

issues: This is a self-submitting pattern: it will only work if `flux batch` can contact a Flux broker from where the script is executed (i.e., inside a Flux instance or on a system configured for direct submission).

The submission uses `--wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner $*"`; unquoted `$*` can collapse/alter argument boundaries. This is not a resource issue, but it can change how many/which arguments are passed to the inner job.
